claims.claim: Direct America very neet and tested ok
claims.evidence: Witness report only shows a used internal combustion engine assembly with visible dirt/wear/corrosion spots; no test results or running/functional evidence is shown.
No photo evidence of a written/transferable guarantee; only the seller’s words mention it.

risks.risk: Engine may not actually run or may have internal faults (compression loss, head/cylinder issues, bearing wear) not visible from exterior condition.
risks.proof: A short video clip of the engine starting from cold and running steadily (no knocking/overheating), plus a compression test screenshot/result.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a non-tested/unknown-condition used engine (worst case: may require major repairs).

risks.risk: Possible corrosion/rust and heavy wear could indicate long storage or coolant/oil neglect, increasing risk of leaks or seized components.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the top cover area, coolant/oil passages, and any rusted spots, plus a leak check (wetness around gaskets/ports) video.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lowest end for used engines with visible wear/corrosion risk.

risks.risk: Missing or incompatible components (starter/alternator/ECU/sensors, wrong harness, wrong mounting/adapter) could prevent installation.
risks.proof: A full photo inventory laid out (starter, alternator, sensors, ECU, harness, mounts) and a photo showing all included parts with part numbers where possible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as engine-only or incomplete kit until all required accessories/mounts are confirmed.

risks.risk: Unknown make/model/variant means wrong engine fitment risk (different displacement, timing setup, or ECU requirements).
risks.proof: Clear close-up photos of the engine ID plate/stamping and any readable markings on the block/head, plus the exact variant name.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unidentified used engine assembly with fitment risk.

risks.risk: Transmission/gearbox compatibility not shown; if the engine is sold with mating parts, mismatch can add cost.
risks.proof: Photos showing whether a gearbox is included and the mating bellhousing/mounting details; provide gearbox model/part number if present.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming no gearbox compatibility is guaranteed (worst case: buyer must source matching parts).

proof_requests: Send clear close-up photos of the engine ID plate/stamping and any readable make/model/variant markings on the block/head.
Provide a video of the engine starting and running (cold start if possible) showing stable idle and no abnormal noises/smoke.
Share any test evidence (compression/leak-down/overheating) as screenshots or photos of results.
Confirm exactly what is included: starter, alternator, sensors, ECU, wiring harness, mounts, and any adapters—show them in one laid-out inventory photo.
Show close-ups of gasket areas and any rust/corrosion spots, and confirm there are no oil/coolant leaks (video or photos).
If any gearbox is included, send photos of the gearbox model/part number and the mating interface.
response.reason: The witness can only confirm it is a used internal combustion engine assembly, but the make/model and any running/test proof are missing. Without those, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
